annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because its title and description promote cryptocurrency exchange earnings of up to 1000% per year, while the speaker presents a $100–$200 daily mining income target and solicits recruitment with a 10% return across five generations. The speaker also forecasts continued CRT growth. A sampled mining dashboard separately requests a transfer after a DGB threshold warning, although the recipient, amount, and whether any transfer occurred are not established, and the speaker acknowledges that prices can fall after sharp rises.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video promotes cryptocurrency-related earning opportunities and expressly links referral activity across five generations to commission income. Mining and trading returns are discussed, but the supplied evidence says users could start mining without paying and does not establish a paid mining or node entry condition required for S04.
